title: Nabiyyii Gaarreen Bocame
intro: Gammoojjii hamaa Arabiyaa durii keessatti namoota ogummaa harkaa adda taʼeen beekaman gidduutti namni tokko mulʼate. Manni isaanii dhagaa jabaa irraa kan kaʼe taʼus, garaan isaanii gaarreen isaan bocan caalaa jabaa ture. Ergamaan waaqa tokko mallattoo dinqii tokko qabate dhufe — garuu of tuuluun fi mormiin bu’aa ariifataa fi sodaachisaa fide. Tajaajilaa kabajamaa sabni isaa qajeelfama irra badiisa filate adda baasuu dandeessaa?
clues: Saba kootti akeekkachiisaa ta’ee gara waaqeffannaa Waaqa Tokkichaatti isaan waamee ergame.
Sabni koo dhagaawwan dinqisiisoo taʼan gidduu jiraachaa turan, manneen jireenyaa dinqisiisoo taʼan gara qarqara gaaraatti bocuu turan.
Kadhannaa koo irratti gaalli dubaraa dinqisiisaa dhagaa jabaa keessaa baate, mallattoo ifa ta’e isa hundumaa danda’u irraa.
Ummanni koo bishaan gaala dubartii kana waliin qooddadhu malee akka hin miine itti hime.
Sabni koo gaala dubaraa irratti shira xaxee ishee hamstrung, badiisa ofii chaappesse.
Kirkirri lafaa sodaachisaan saba koo rukutee, mana jireenyaa isaanii keessatti sochii tokko malee kufanii hafan.

trial.label: Qormaanni murteessaan maal ture?
options: Fara’oon abbaa irree tokko waliin wal-dura dhaabbachuu

outcome.label: Hireen dhumaa isaanii maal ture?
options: Kirkira lafaa akka tasaa samii irraa dhufe
outcome.answer: Kirkira lafaa akka tasaa samii irraa dhufe

arabic: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَعَادٌۭ وَثَمُودُ
verse: And if they deny you, [O Muḥammad] - so, before them, did the people of Noah and ʿAad and Thamūd deny [their prophets], (22:42)
